'''Sajius''' is the author of the book [[Commentary on the Dragon]], which contains the line: "He shall hold a blade of light in his hands, and the three shall be one". 

He believed it referred to the unification of three kingdoms, but [[Min]] and [[Cadsuane]] believe it refers to Callandor. It was this passage that set Cadsuane to investigating Callandor more thoroughly.
